name: White Lithium Grease

features.text: automotive: doors, hood and trunk latches and hinges, antennas, and battery cables. Other uses: snowmobiles, ATV’s, machinery, gears, pulleys, conveyors, garage-door channels, and lawn-&-garden equipment.
Long-lasting, heat and water-resistant formula. Working Temperature (0°F to 300°F).

description: A heavy-duty, lubricant designed to reduce friction between moving metal and/or plastic surfaces. It quickly sets to a thick film that clings to surfaces such as doors, hoods and trunk latches and hinges. Also, it is used on speedometer cables, distributors, cams and battery cables.
application: Shake well before using. Holding can 4 to 8 inches from surface, spray directly on parts to be treated. Use extension tube for hard-to- reach areas.
